problem: Compare these five animals using IUCNRedList.org -- Wild Water Buffalo, Siberian Taimen, Yellow-eared Parrot, Saiga tatarica, and Komodo Dragon; find their earliest Red List assessment dates, and list these in chronological order. (Keep answer under 100 words.)
answer: Wild Water Buffalo, 1965; Komodo Dragon, 1986; Yellow-eared Parrot, 1988; Saiga tatarica, 1996; and Siberian Taimen, 2012
